command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '===IDENTITY==='
printf 'host='; hostname
printf 'user='; whoami
echo '===SERVICES==='
for s in omega-chatgpt-mcp.service omega-local-effect-adapter.service frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service frankenstein-local-bridge.service; do
  printf '%s active=' "$s"; systemctl --user is-active "$s" || true
  systemctl --user show "$s" -p MainPID -p ExecMainStartTimestamp --value 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/  /' || true
done
echo '===DEPLOYED_BLOB_BINDING==='
check_blob(){ f="$1"; exp="$2"; if [ ! -f "$f" ]; then echo "MISSING $f"; return; fi; got=$(git hash-object "$f"); if [ "$got" = "$exp" ]; then echo "MATCH $f $got"; else echo "MISMATCH $f got=$got expected=$exp"; fi; }
check_blob "$HOME/.local/lib/omega-chatgpt-mcp/omega_chatgpt_mcp.py" 8e43de93b7548de89e6514377c6b128b883acb4a
check_blob "$HOME/.local/lib/omega-chatgpt-mcp/omega_chatgpt_mcp_fallback.py" a352f6885679b1e64fe989d364db89ca810f6aaf
check_blob "$HOME/.local/lib/omega-chatgpt-mcp/omega_local_effect_adapter.py" 8bb9add27869930d33bfa39a00383332982277f5
check_blob "$HOME/.local/lib/omega-chatgpt-mcp/omega_grid_relay.py" 36fc3da2f7b7401ff6cc56d10464a0404579ec19
echo '===HEALTH_AND_MCP==='
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, pathlib, urllib.request
env={}
for line in pathlib.Path.home().joinpath('.config/omega/omega-mcp.env').read_text().splitlines():
    if '=' in line and not line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
        k,v=line.split('=',1); env[k]=v
token=env.get('OMEGA_MCP_TOKEN','')
port=env.get('OMEGA_MCP_PORT','8789')
base=f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}'
with urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/health',timeout=3) as r:
    h=json.loads(r.read().decode())
print('health',json.dumps(h,separators=(',',':')))
def rpc(payload):
    req=urllib.request.Request(base+'/',data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept':'application/json'},method='POST')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=5) as r: return json.loads(r.read().decode())
ls=rpc({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':'777-list','method':'tools/list','params':{}})
names=[x.get('name') for x in ls.get('result',{}).get('tools',[])]
print('tools',json.dumps(names,separators=(',',':')))
ts=rpc({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':'777-transport','method':'tools/call','params':{'name':'omega_transport_status','arguments':{}}})
res=ts.get('result',{}).get('structuredContent',{})
print('transport',json.dumps(res,separators=(',',':')))
PY
